searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he generation 7 — gevurah risk critique the awtsmoos pours infinite light, yet truthful borders guard the flame; awtsmoos.com must never index private worlds, invent domain truth, or confuse two hosts as one name. hard constraints 1. never force comments into sitemap if the public renderer cannot resolve them. 2. never hard code 19 comment ids; repair the shared invariant. 3. never trust raw host blindly for canonical generation. 4. never override explicit authored canonical/robots metadata unless invalid or unsafe. 5. never index preview/editor/admin/auth/private project surfaces. 6. never assume a custom domain is primary merely because a request reached it; use verified routing metadata where available. 7. never expose account/email/private owner metadata in json ld. 8. never create a global sitemap for user sites unless route enumeration is authoritative and bounded. 9. preserve unrelated concurrent agent work and current origin/main. 10. whole file rewrites only; no partial patch operations. 11. every touched source file must remain modular and <=120 lines where feasible. 12. test with the real canonical dosdb when dynamic entities are involved. architecture preference shared resolver/predicate for comment sitemap and public renderer. shared html seo enrichment module at the final public host response boundary. small pure helpers for host normalization, canonical choice, metadata extraction, and semantic injection. routing adapter supplies trusted public origin context; enrichment module never reads secrets or mutates non html responses.

searchText: phase one — chesed possibility field observed defect: olam h3 validation and error bodies are correct, but live public failure responses use http 200. the dynamic server proves ordinary returned objects normalize to 200, while explicit response envelopes carry statuscode to node's response. possible solutions considered: throw exposed errors from every handler; set a raw node response status through request context; modify the global dynamic server to infer body.status; return explicit transport envelopes directly from every route lambda; add one olam local http adapter that converts handler bodies into the framework's supported json envelope. the fifth option is strongest. it avoids global behavior changes, preserves handler purity, keeps browser json unchanged, and makes the transport boundary explicit. shadow work created by the fix: prove success remains http 200; prove malformed create becomes http 400; prove missing credential becomes http 503; prove invalid task becomes http 400; prove browser client still parses error metadata; prove no secret leaks; prove image replacement still sends fresh bytes; re run public ui regression because route transport changed beneath the app.
